Hardware modules (4D radar, thermal, DMS) carry BOM + assembly; margin lower, rising modestly with scale and supplier negotiation.
Autonomy kits + compute boxes: blended HW+SW; SW/licence attach lifts margin sharply after the FY2027 pilot phase.
Pure SaaS / AI licence — software economics, ~80–90% gross margin throughout.
